name: Magda Ellenstein
source:
The protagonist was born to common citizen parents from the Slum. After a fire killed her family, Eliza Ellenstein and Duke Sakan picked her out for her beauty and, after introducing herself, she was told to forget her name and was renamed Magda Ellenstein.

[From [url=https://helix-waltz.fandom.com/wiki/Magda_Ellenstein#articleComments]Helix Waltz Wiki[/url]]
